result.title: CGDT-CESN: Correlation-Guided and Dynamics-Trained Clustered Echo State Network for Multivariate Time-Series Prediction
result.summary: Accurate prediction of multivariate time series requires models that simultaneously capture variable-specific dynamics and cross-variable interactions. In this work, a Correlation-Guided and Dynamics-Trained Clustered Echo State Network (CGDT-CESN) is proposed, which comprises a modular reservoir architecture with each cluster distinctly specializing in one of the variables in the multivariate time series. An innovative reservoir design is proposed in which inter-cluster connections are enabled by empirically observed correlations among variables, providing a data-driven coupling mechanism. Apart from conventional readout training, inter-cluster connection weights informed by correlations are trained, which in turn allows the reservoir to capture time-varying cross-variable dependencies without sacrificing computational efficiency and further improves forecasting accuracy. The prediction performance of CGDT-CESN is found to be superior to that of the conventional ESN when evaluated on two fundamentally different datasets: Twitter information cascade evolution and solar wind forecasting. Also, the improvement in performance is preserved across multiple prediction horizons, even when presented with a low volume of data. By unifying cluster-specific specialization with learned inter-variable coupling, CGDT-CESN offers a principled, data-driven route to multivariate time series prediction.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 CGDT-CESN：用模块化储备池为多变量时间序列的每个变量分簇，按变量间经验相关性建立并训练簇间连接，从而在保持计算效率的同时捕捉时变的跨变量依赖，提升预测精度。
AI.relevance_reason: 储备池的循环状态更新与「相关性引导的结构化耦合」可能为 LVR 中 latent 状态的递推生成、状态间关系建模提供方法线索；但论文面向纯数值时间序列，与视觉证据、VLM 推理无直接关联，需人工核查其可迁移性。
